rounds.prompt: How many words are in the Bee Movie script?
rounds.source: The widely shared Bee Movie (2007) dialogue transcript, about 9,200 words (TeraBox's Bee Movie script guide gives the same figure)

rounds.prompt: How many people worldwide live within 10 km (6.2 miles) of an ocean coast?
rounds.source: Scientific Reports (Nature), "Accelerating growth of human coastal populations at the global and continent levels: 2000-2018" (Cosby et al., Mississippi State University / Oak Ridge National Laboratory LandScan data)

rounds.prompt: Czechs drink more beer per person than anyone else in the world. How much beer does the average Czech drink in a year?
rounds.source: Czech Statistical Office (ČSÚ) food consumption statistics for 2024: 130.5 liters of beer per resident
